caption_L1: This is a bar graph called From the following list , please pick the five main environmental issues that you are worried about .. The y-axis measures Response as categorical scale with Agricultural pollution (use of pesticides. fertilizers, etc.) on one end and Water pollution (seas, rivers, lakes and underground sources) at the other while the x-axis shows Share of respondents using scale with a minimum of 0.0 and a maximum of 0.6.
caption_L2L3: Water and air pollution, alongside the impact of chemicals on our health are the most common concerns of those surveyed. Traffic jams and other urban specific problems are of least concern. The other concerns listed are reasonably equally concerning to those surveyed - with between 0.30 and 0.40 of people surveyed worries about waste, consumption habits, extinction of species and shortage of drinking water.
